name: Linear Regression
learningObjectives: Understand how linear regression models relationships in data
Learn how gradient descent optimizes model parameters
Interpret key regression metrics (MSE, RMSE, R², MAE)
Recognize the impact of learning rate on model training
Visualize the relationship between data and the fitted line

controls.label: Dataset
controls.tooltip: Choose a dataset to train on

controls.label: Learning Rate
controls.tooltip: Controls how quickly the model learns. Too high may overshoot, too low may converge slowly.

controls.label: Epochs
controls.tooltip: Number of training iterations. More epochs allow the model to learn better but take longer.

visualizations.title: Data & Regression Line
visualizations.description: Scatter plot showing the data points and the fitted regression line

visualizations.title: Training Loss
visualizations.description: Line chart showing how the loss decreases during training

metrics.name: Mean Squared Error
metrics.description: Average squared difference between predictions and actual values

metrics.name: Root Mean Squared Error
metrics.description: Square root of MSE, in the same units as the target

metrics.name: R² Score
metrics.description: Proportion of variance explained by the model (1.0 is perfect)

metrics.name: Mean Absolute Error
metrics.description: Average absolute difference between predictions and actual values
